notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 75-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.87, creatinine 0.92, hemoglobin 13.7, platelets 199, sodium 138, wbc 6.9; vitals dbp 76-82, heart_rate 83-87, map 92-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 123-127, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.89, hemoglobin 13.9, platelets 195, sodium 139, wbc 6.6; vitals dbp 76-82, heart_rate 83-86, map 92-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 121-128, spo2 96-98, temp 36.7-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 75-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
